title: Vehicle
description: Identity record for one vehicle configuration. Specs are stored as claims, not here.

vehicle_id.description: Slug: {make}-{model}[-{trim}]-{year}, e.g. 'lucid-air-pure-2026'. Include the trim only when needed to tell configurations apart.

lineage_id.description: Groups model years of the same nameplate for evolution charts, e.g. 'tesla-model-y'

region.description: Spec market. US EPA figures assumed unless noted.

status.description: Whether this configuration is on sale as of status_checked_date. Use unverified_availability until confirmed against a current source.
